verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a customer-facing feedback widget that routes submissions into an organization's central 'Feedback list' (or a chosen project), which functions as a single intake repository for customer input, and an agent turns submissions into intentions/tasks. However, there is no evidence of a distinct colleague/internal feedback intake channel, nor any explicit 'search' capability across the repository. missing for 10: evidence of colleague-submitted feedback intake, explicit search/filter functionality over the feedback repository, and independent corroboration.
